units.title: Preserve selected outcome custody across session handoff and causal restart
units.objective: Make sanctioned cross-session resume preserve the exact selected outcome and failure state, and permit a stalled or parked lineage to adopt a different mechanism only through an exact same-outcome causal restart delta with append-only transition history, without changing ordinary pre-write authority.

included: Strict session-transfer, causal-restart-delta, and restart-transition contracts
Automatic exact selected-state preservation on sanctioned cross-session resume
Preflighted claim/tracker mutation with exact rollback or typed incomplete failure
Explicit same-project stalled-or-parked causal restart command
Same owner, project, outcome, consumer, canonical journey, target, and authority validation
Retained predecessor binding, lease state, counters, failure boundary, failure count, and failed-evidence references
Idempotent exact replay and competing-restart rejection
Post-transfer and post-restart selected pre-write observations with ordinary exit preservation
One real Plan 118 causal transition and one cross-session resume control
Evidence, guide, plan, graph, index, and roadmap reconciliation
excluded: Independent reviewer-attestation enforcement or break glass
Semantic proof that a changed mechanism is genuinely different
Project Graph owner-class resolution or active-outcome WIP ceilings
A new global lease or outcome registry
Cross-project, cross-worktree, or cross-branch successor activation
Automatic selection for unrelated new sessions or repositories
Outcome blocking, default hook activation, installer or fleet rollout, shell interception, deployment, release, or cost controls

outputs: Strict OutcomeSessionTransferV1, RestartDeltaV1, and OutcomeRestartTransitionV1 contracts
Sanctioned cross-session resume that retains the exact selected outcome and failure state
One explicit same-project causal restart command with exact predecessor and successor bindings
Append-only transfer/restart history in the existing exact tracker
Post-transfer and post-restart selected pre-write both-sign evidence
Operator guidance and revision-bound pilot evidence with explicit promotion limits

acceptance.criterion: Sanctioned cross-session resume preserves every selected outcome and lease fact except exact runtime identity, appends one transfer record, and leaves selected resolution usable only by the new session.
evidence_required: Exact transfer contract and identity-diff assertions
acceptance.negative_control: Invalid or tampered selected state leaves claim ownership unchanged; injected partial mutation restores exact preflight bytes or reports a typed incomplete transition.

acceptance.criterion: Only stalled or parked selected state can enter causal restart, and the successor retains exact owner, project, outcome, consumer, canonical journey, progress dimensions, target, authority, and direct predecessor lineage.
evidence_required: Active, recovery-required, complete, changed-outcome, changed-journey, and missing-predecessor denials
acceptance.negative_control: A fresh scenario cannot be relabeled as a restart by supplying prose or a mismatched digest.

acceptance.criterion: An accepted restart permanently retains predecessor binding, contract, lease, state, counters, failure boundary/count, and failed-evidence references while replacing only the current selected binding.
acceptance.negative_control: No successful transition can erase or decrement predecessor failure facts.

acceptance.criterion: The successor current binding resolves through the existing selected pre-write observer while ordinary claim admission and exit behavior remain unchanged.
acceptance.negative_control: A selected transition error remains advisory and cannot alter the ordinary decision or exit code.

claim_policy.eligibility_rule: Plan 117 is accepted; one exact Plan 118 claimed lane owns only the listed contracts, lifecycle seam, CLI, tests, scenarios, evidence, guide, plan, and graph paths.

units.title: Reconcile the plan index and roadmap after restart custody is accepted
units.objective: Publish truthful Plan 118 index and roadmap state only after the executable restart-custody unit has accepted evidence, without forcing its shared documentation paths into the implementation claim.

included: Add or update the Plan 118 plan-index row
Reconcile the roadmap frontier and observe-only promotion boundary
excluded: Code, tests, scenarios, evidence, guide, plan-body, or work-graph behavior changes
Independent review, owner-class resolution, cross-project restart, blocking, installation, deployment, release, or fleet claims

outputs: Plan 118 index row matching accepted evidence
Roadmap state naming the next unimplemented enforcement dependency

dependencies.rationale: Shared status documentation must describe accepted runtime evidence rather than anticipated implementation.

acceptance.criterion: The index and roadmap match accepted Plan 118 evidence and remain truthful about the observe-only, same-project boundary and unimplemented independent review, owner-class resolution, cross-project successors, and hard blocking.
acceptance.negative_control: No reviewer-attestation, Project Graph resolver, installer, hook promotion, downstream repository, deployment, or fleet completion claim appears.

claim_policy.eligibility_rule: Claim only after ORST01 is accepted and the two shared documentation paths have no conflicting live owner.
